07_car.prompt: Using Image 1 for the exact geometry, framing and layout, and Image 2 as the colour key for materials, create: A low street-level photograph of a gleaming pearl-white Lamborghini-style Italian V12 supercar driving along a quiet coastal Gold Coast street lined with contemporary homes, palms and street lights — razor-sharp angular wedge body, hexagonal air intakes, Y-shaped LED headlights and tail lights, low scissor-door profile, wide aggressive stance, carbon-fibre splitter and diffuser, large forged black alloy wheels with gold brake calipers, no badges, no logos, no lettering anywhere on the car. Keep the exact camera position, lens, crop and horizon of Image 1 with no zoom or re-crop, and every building, object and person exactly where it sits in Image 1. Image 2 is a flat colour label map of the same frame and is only a key: none of its flat colours appear in the photograph. Wherever Image 2 is red the surface is warm spotted-gum timber; blue is clear turquoise pool water; light grey is smooth off-white honed concrete; white is crisp white render; cyan is floor-to-ceiling low-iron glass in slim black frames reflecting sky with warm lived-in interiors visible through it; black is slim charcoal steel and bronze metalwork; navy is the deep blue-green Pacific Ocean with rolling swell; pale lilac is white breaking surf and foam; yellow is pale golden Gold Coast beach sand; ochre is wet compacted sand at the waterline; green is lush buffalo lawn and soft dune grass; dark green is tropical foliage; teal is a clipped dense hedge; brown is palm trunks and tree bark; magenta is linen upholstery, cushions and soft furnishings in natural white, sand and oatmeal tones; orange is honed stone benchtops and white porcelain; dark grey is asphalt road; near-black is a switched-off wall-mounted screen; purple marks a real person.  Bright clear Gold Coast morning sun, soft natural shadows, clean blue sky with light coastal haze, bright and airy, true-to-life colour, magazine-grade editorial architectural photography, real photograph on a real camera, no CGI, no render look, no text, no watermark.
